svg.text: The ring: is this object standing in open table?
Seen from above, camera off to the lower left
100% of the seen ring is bare table, 22% unseen
2. At the table's edge, beside a cable
91% of the seen ring is bare table, 31% unseen
obstacle (kept out of the planner's way)
3. Why some of the ring is unseen
Side view: a tall object's shadow
Hidden table is unseen, not 'something else'
A scan target needs at least 90% of the cells it saw to be bare table, and at most 25% of its ring unseen. The ring is a 5mm grid from 5mm (dashed) to 60mm (solid) outside the object's box.
